pages.summary: Astoria recibe a Scorpius y sigue a Hermione y Daphne al velero. Pansy y Blaise quedan con Robin y Arianna mientras Draco propone recoger las cosas.

panels.scene: On DRY low rock, Draco at left gently releases the one pearl platinum baby Scorpius after Astoria has fully and safely received him at her chest. One natural small head with platinum tuft and blue gray eyes atop gray wrap. Astoria at right in scarf and terracotta+patterned cream pareo supports clearly with two connected arms; Draco empty now. Single adult orange glass placed flat on dry stone away from child. No words.

Astoria now holds baby Scorpius safely as she looks toward Draco and speaks one complete request. Astoria only speaker, warm calm face, hands and wrists bare, firmly supporting wrap. Draco both hands empty and listens. Short plank gangway to anchored navy yacht behind only.
dialogue: Astoria: Ayuda a los chicos a encargarse de la basura, por favor.

panels.scene: Same normal short affectionate cheek kiss as she says goodbye. Astoria braces gray-wrapped baby Scorpius securely in two distinct forearms against her own chest away from adults' faces. Kisses adult Draco's cheek from side, he slightly smiles. Focus portrait visible two accurate profiles, no words. No babe between faces.

Medium side view. Astoria carrying the sole baby Scorpius against her chest has reached the high OTHER end of the connected wood plank gangway on the side deck. She turns her head back toward dry rock and says both complete short sentences in one clear correct bubble. Same ocher scarf and quiet face. Tied ivory sails, pale bronze wood rig and plank connection. Hermione and Daphne ahead off-frame; no cloned figure.
dialogue: Astoria: No se tarden. Sus hijos ya deben tener hambre.

panels.scene: Wide shoreside held-child moment. At left Pansy in black with natural correct lips, eye read above rectangular dark lens frames, one securely held chestnut boy Robin in pale wrap, navy captain cap and blue yellow-duck shorts. He lightly taps her lower lip with tiny attached single hand; Pansy gently moves his hand away with her own attached LEFT hand wearing fine linked H R P not cuff/ring. At right navy-shirt Blaise securely supports one golden Arianna turquoise; Arianna taps his shirt with one hand and moves her natural feet. Different small human faces, no duplicate fingers. No words.

Pansy left lifts gaze toward Blaise, both have babies held against torso. One Pansy short line with exact wording. Their separate two babies, proper two adult wrists and body fit. Pansy's short chin bob and left gold clip, her silver left bracelet only. B short compact tight black coils no right gold.

Blaise responds to Pansy with whole short line, one bubble. Pale golden curls and pale turquoise wrap on Arianna in secure arms. Pansy and navy captain cap Robin to side, cream wrap, visibly different. No other speaker. Opaque linens, clean warm light.

Wide three adults, one Draco now without child speaking to Pansy left holding Robin and Blaise center holding Arianna. Draco platinum and pale stripe, slightly awkward expression. Valentina red and Allegra terracotta stand far silent at stone edge if visible, no attention. Only one adult orange flute left on dry stone where it was placed in panel 1. No Gnocchi or extra children. One Draco balloon exact whole sentence with tail to him toward right.

pages.transcript:
Capítulo 13 · 89

Astoria recibe a Scorpius y sigue a Hermione y Daphne al velero. Pansy y Blaise quedan con Robin y Arianna mientras Draco propone recoger las cosas.
Astoria: Ayuda a los chicos a encargarse de la basura, por favor.
Astoria: No se tarden. Sus hijos ya deben tener hambre.
Pansy: No digas nada.
Blaise: No pensaba hacerlo.
Draco: Yo empezaría a recoger.
pages.review: PDF655 cotejado con cinco globos íntegros. Astoria recibe a Scorpius, deja la copa en roca y habla desde el extremo del puente que llega al velero. En el gesto de Robin se distinguen la mano infantil y la derecha desnuda de Pansy; Blaise conserva a Arianna y Draco ya tiene los brazos libres.
